steps.title: Initialize LockPlayTube application project structure
steps.description: Set up base project configuration with Java 17 Temurin, Gradle 8.5, target SDK 34, and compile SDK 34 for background YouTube playback.

steps.title: Configure permissions and application components in AndroidManifest
steps.description: Declare Internet, Foreground Service Media Playback, Notification, and Wake Lock permissions in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Configure app theme and visual asset resources
steps.description: Define dark-themed color palette, UI background drawables, vector icons, and layout styles in values and drawable resources.

steps.title: Initialize offline API schema configuration
steps.description: Configure api_schema.json to specify standalone offline architecture without remote database requirements.

steps.title: Implement local SQLite watch history storage helper
steps.description: Create HistoryDbHelper and HistoryItem classes to persist watched YouTube video URLs, timestamps, and titles locally.

steps.title: Implement history list view adapter and UI components
steps.description: Construct HistoryAdapter and activity_history layout for displaying, selecting, and deleting watch history records.

steps.title: Build watch history management Activity screen
steps.description: Implement HistoryActivity to manage watched items list display, history clearing dialogs, and video re-navigation.

steps.title: Implement background audio playback service and Notification controls
steps.description: Construct BackgroundAudioService with foreground service handling, media session callback handling, audio focus management, and lock screen notification integration.

steps.title: Implement trial access and paywall access manager
steps.description: Create TrialPaywallManager to query cloud worker server status, manage device ID registration, and handle premium status validation.

steps.title: Construct main WebView browser and background audio JavaScript bridge
steps.description: Set up MainActivity layout with header controls, dynamic QR code loader, paywall overlay container, and error retry state views.

steps.title: Integrate JavaScript media state listeners and single video session management
steps.description: Enhance MainActivity to inject video bridge scripts, handle auto-pause on previous videos, manage media service binding, and enforce paywall lock state.

steps.title: Building LockPlayTube
steps.description: Assemble and compile the complete LockPlayTube native Android app package using Gradle assembleDebug.
